kjv: evil doing, iniquity, matter of wrong

occurrences.text: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:
Or else let these same here say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,
